title: React vs Vue: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
React vs Vue: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: Vue's leaner core often yields slightly higher raw throughput in benchmarks.
• Latency: Both offer excellent runtime performance; React's concurrent rendering can offer advantages for complex UIs.
• Consistency: React's JSX and ecosystem provide a more opinionated, consistent development experience.
• Failure Modes: Both are resilient, with React's ecosystem offering more mature error boundary patterns.
• Operational Overhead: Vue generally has a lower learning curve, while React's larger community can offer more readily available solutions.

Recommendation: For massive, complex enterprise applications with diverse teams, React's ecosystem and patterns often provide better long-term scalability. For rapid development and simpler applications, Vue is an excellent choice.
